verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no no-code workflow engine that reacts to hire, role-change or departure events. Event hooks (outbound HTTPS calls on org events) are a developer building block that needs a custom consumer to act on them. The SCIM guides cover building provisioning integrations rather than admin-configured lifecycle automation, and the MCP server is natural-language admin tooling, not event-triggered automation. None of these earns credit under the partial-credit rules.
